name: KISS x 200 Toaru Bunkou no Hanashi
source:
Main character is a new teacher who just graduated from college. He gets directed to a village with just 32 inhabitants and only 4 school students. These four students are all cute girls, and they don't even know what "kiss" means. But with protagonist arrival that's bound to change.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位刚从大学毕业的新老师。他被带到一个只有32名居民和4名学生的村庄。这四个学生都是可爱的女孩子，她们连“吻”是什么意思都不知道。但随着主角的到来，这种情况势必会发生变化。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
